verdict.rationale: Brex's developer portal documents a broad public REST API surface covering accounting, budgets, team, expenses, payments, transactions, travel, onboarding and webhooks. It adds a quickstart, a Postman collection, and an llms.txt index, so an AI-native user can drive core spend operations programmatically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths (all probed paths returned 404, although per-API spec pages exist under /openapi/).
